chapter: Big band, Chicago players, recordings and gospel
title: Guy Warren and Africa Speaks, America Answers
summary: Saunders made an album with Guy Warren, who later went back to Ghana.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: And then I made this album with Guy Warren, Africa Speaks, America Answers.
Oh, Guy Warren. I remember Guy Warren.
I think I may have that. That was an LP.
I think I may have that. I remember when Guy was here in the early '60s --
And then he went back to Africa.
And he made some records there, I think.
He made some in New York. He left here and went to New York, then he went back to Ghana.
Yeah, he sent me a record or two from Ghana.

Oh, yeah, right. Well, he -- yeah, he played all of the things, and he was very interesting because he was descriptive of everything, if you get to know it or are talking drums, and the congas and the bongos and the --
